snippet.title: ASTRAL COURT DX - ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
WUH OH! You're in BIG trouble with the Astral Courthouse, Heaven's one and only courthouse, for a millionth time! If you want to avoid execution, you're in luck! The court has granted you a special challenge, with the reward being you can get off free. You must platform atop of the scales of justice whilst the court throws whatever they can at you during each trial (aka level). In order to pass a trial, you must collect "shinies" - little stars that spawn randomly across the area, you need to meet a certain quota of them to win. Get through all of the court's trials and you're good to go!

This game was originally just a gamejam game, called "Astral Courthouse", but I decided to expand it out into a much bigger game - mainly because I just wanted an excuse to have an endless mode version of the game. This demo contains...
- Endless mode, containing 5 of the 9 courses (worlds, essentially) Astral Court DX is planned to have
- 2 of the planned 6 playable characters (+ a bonus character exclusive to this demo)
- The tutorial

Extra things to note about this demo...
- Each course featured here only has about half of its normal level set, meaning there's still a lot left to be seen of these courses in the full game
- Each endless mode run only lasts for 9 levels, meaning you may want to try a few replays in order to see all the courses

The full version of this game is planned to release like decently soon, but I got college to deal with so I'm not shooting for any deadline yet. Anyway, enjoy!!

Link to the demo, only can get this demo on Sfghq btw:
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/astral-court-dx-sage-25-preview-demo.2633/
